question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
  s.avg_loss_rate,
  s.stddev_loss_rate,
  (s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) AS lower_bound,
  (s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) AS upper_bound,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < (s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_one_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= (s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) AND v."loss_rate_%" <= (s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_one_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > (s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_one_stddev
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
GROUP BY s.avg_loss_rate, s.stddev_loss_rate
